educationalGoal: Students will lean: (1) rational functions, irrational functions, and exponential functions. (2) trigonometric functions. (3) the nature and usage of functions. (4) changes in functions and to master the differential method. (5) integration methods.
advice: This is a basic course in calculus. We will cover the following topics: Chapter 1 1.1 Functions and graphs; 1.2 Sequences and limits; 1.3 Exponential functions; 1.4 Logarithmic functions; 1.5 Trigonometric functions Chapter 2 Integrated subject I Chapter 3 3.1 Limits of functions; 3.2 Differentiation and derivatives; 3.3 Formulas of derivatives; 3.4 Differentiation of composite functions; 3.5 Increase / decrease and the extreme value of functions Chapter 4 4.1 Indefinite integrals; 4.2 Definite integrals; 4.3 Integration method and its applications Chapter 5 Integrated subject II Students are expected to utilize the Math and Science Education Research Center or the office hours of the teacher.
books: Text book: Calculus I for Bioscience and Chemistry [Kanazawa Institute of Technology]
requiredKnowledge: Basic calculation capability for mathematical formulas (organization of formulas, expansion and factorization of formulas, division of formulas, calculation of fractional formulas, etc.)

activityGoals.body: Understand the concept of a function.
Understand exponential and logarithmic laws and draw appropriate graphs.
Understand trigonometric functions and draw their graphs.
Be able to find the derivatives and indefinite integrals of basic functions, and to apply to definite integrals.
Understand the meanings of fundamental English words of mathematics.
Be able to attend each class, and make a strong effort to understand the contents of the class.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Fully understand the concept and graph of a function. (2) Understand exponential and logarithmic laws, and be able to draw the appropriate graphs, particularly as they apply to specific phenomena. (3) Understand trigonometric functions and draw the appropriate graphs. (4) Differentiate various functions. (5) Integrate various functions and use results to calculate definite integrals. (6) Attend each class and accomplish understand the subject.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the concept of a function. (2) Understand exponential and logarithmic laws, and be able to draw the appropriate graphs. (3) Understand basic trigonometric functions and be able to draw the appropriate graphs. (4) Differentiate basic functions. (5) Integrate basic functions and use to the results to calculate definite integrals. (6) Attend each class and understand the subject.
